title: Inner-count coordinate
statement: For every counting-algorithm state $\sigma$ and natural number $z$, the register vector of $\sigma$ has value $\sigma.\mathrm{cnt}$ at coordinate $13$.
replaced:
For any state $\sigma$ and natural number $z$, the value of the register vector
associated with $\sigma$ at coordinate $13$ is the inner count $\mathrm{cnt}$ of
$\sigma$.
